name: Bharawan Da Dhaba (Ranjit Avenue)
why_it_matters: The Ranjit Avenue branch of the 1912 Town Hall original — same family, AC dining, parking. The version Amritsaris recommend to relatives staying at Mall of Amritsar hotels who don't want the old-city walk.
insider_tip: Ranjit Avenue branch portions are slightly smaller than Town Hall but the dal makhani is identical. Book a table after 8.30pm to avoid the family-dinner peak.
signature_address: SCO 104, Vishal Mega Mart, near Police Station, B-Block, Ranjit Avenue, Amritsar 143001

name: The Yellow Chilli
why_it_matters: Sanjeev Kapoor's polished-Indian chain, Amritsar branch at GRD Towers — same Lalla Mussa dal (slow-cooked over 24 hours) the format is built around. Sit-down dining with full bar in a city otherwise dominated by dhabas.
insider_tip: Order the Lalla Mussa, not the dal makhani — the slow cook on the former is the chain's actual signature. Tasting menu on weekdays runs 25% cheaper than weekend pricing.
signature_address: Chhatwal Hotel & Resorts, SCO-108, GRD Towers, District Shopping Centre, Ranjit Avenue, Amritsar 143001

name: The BrewMaster
why_it_matters: One of Amritsar's first proper microbrewery-restaurants on Ranjit Avenue — craft beer was rare in Punjab outside Chandigarh until places like this opened. Music-and-food format, not a quiet-dinner address.
insider_tip: Beer flight (4 small glasses) is the right order before you commit to a pint — the wheat and Belgian-style are the sharper of the four. Kitchen lags drinks; order food first.

name: Kulcha Land
why_it_matters: Sucha Singh started 'Chungi Wale De Kulche' near the city tax post; opened the present Ranjit Avenue outlet around 2004. The menu is seven kulchas and chole. He insists on Amritsar municipal water for the dough — claims it's the city's secret.
insider_tip: The aloo kulcha is the calibration order — if his version doesn't beat your previous best, walk out. Open from morning till around 5pm; this is not a dinner address.
signature_address: DISTT Shopping Complex, opposite MK Hotel Centre, B-Block, Ranjit Avenue, Amritsar 143001

name: Adarsh Meat Shop
why_it_matters: The Ranjit Avenue address Amritsaris drive to for the cuts the Lawrence Road tandoors don't run — chaap, smoked ribs, brain curry. Tucked into C-Block Market Complex near Rose Garden; locals point you the last hundred metres because the signboard is small.
insider_tip: Order the chaap before 9pm — they finish the marinade by then and refuse to half-do it for late orders. Eat-in queue is shorter than the takeaway counter on weekends.
signature_address: C-Block Market Complex, near Rose Garden, Ranjit Avenue, Amritsar 143001

name: Charming Chicken
why_it_matters: Amarjeet Singh's family restaurant on Majitha Road — owner-on-the-floor format where the chef is also the host. Quieter, AC, family-table-friendly version of the Beera/Surjit format. Big banquet hall upstairs for weddings.
insider_tip: Sunday afternoons are full; book or arrive at 1pm sharp. Their butter chicken is gravier than Beera's; if you prefer dry tandoori, order the half-tandoori instead.

name: Punjab Province (Hyatt Regency)
why_it_matters: Hyatt Regency Amritsar's signature North-Indian bistro on G.T. Road, themed around old-city Amritsari street food taken upmarket. Tasting menu re-imagines paya, kulcha and Amritsari fish for a hotel-dining audience without losing the spice register.
insider_tip: Lunch buffet on weekdays is the value entry — same kitchen, half the dinner price. For dinner, request the chef's tasting menu when booking; off-menu and worth the upcharge.
signature_address: Hyatt Regency Amritsar, MBM Farms, G.T. Road, Amritsar 143001

name: Kebabs & Kurries (WelcomHotel by ITC)
why_it_matters: ITC's Kebabs & Kurries format — the chain showcases dum-cooked Awadhi and Punjabi recipes using ITC's Sigree spice masters' research. Amritsar branch is at WelcomHotel Raja Sansi, near the airport — the dinner before a morning flight, more than a city visit.
insider_tip: Kakori kebab and galouti are the menu's purpose; everything else is good-not-great. Hotel guests get earlier reservation slots, walk-ins from the city should book 24h ahead.
signature_address: WelcomHotel by ITC Hotels, Raja Sansi, Amritsar 143108
